name: Trace Quality Metric Registry
purpose: Define metrics for source-relation trace completeness, retained-feature clarity, and loss-accounting sufficiency.

metrics.definition: A measure of whether all required source-relation components are explicitly linked in the trace.
Evaluates whether retained features are precisely defined within the projection domain.
Measures the thoroughness of documented abstractions and feature losses.
metrics.calculation: qualitative audit score based on gap identification

metrics.definition: Boolean check if the projection depth (PD-1 to PD-4) is explicitly stated.
Boolean check if the recoverability class (RCOV-0 to RCOV-3) is explicitly stated.

governance_rules.rule: High trace quality scores do not imply physical identity.
Low quality scores trigger mandatory REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Metric scores replace manual audit of loss accounting.
